outcome: Maternal outcomes (demographics, substance use, BMI, blood type, parity, prenatal care, rupture of membranes, mode of delivery, postpartum hemorrhage)
Neonatal outcomes (umbilical artery S/D ratio, gestational age at delivery, birth weight, Apgar scores, fetal sex)
cohort: 361 women who delivered and had obstetric sonograms in a New York academic hospital between June 2019 and December 2020
finding: A statistically significant association was found between placental location and 5-minute Apgar score, with lower scores observed in infants with anterior placentas.
